sections.summary: Cold-open teaser where Tyson tells Charles Liu he has an issue with the wave-particle duality, setting up the topic.

Tyson and Charles Liu discuss quantum physics, covering Liu's new book, the history of Planck and de Broglie, the double-slit experiment, why wave-particle duality is misleading, and propose viewing all matter as simultaneously wave and particle.
Tyson thanks Charles Liu, recaps the conversation as being about quantum physics, and signs off with 'keep looking up.'
